title: Reporting Verbs: How It Was Said
goal: Learn the reporting verbs that say how something was said, and which of them take the indicative or the subjunctive.
grammar: Reporting verbs (afirmar, explicar, añadir, admitir, negar, advertir, recordar, reprochar, sugerir) and their mood

items: I can choose a reporting verb that says how something was said (afirmar, explicar, añadir, admitir, negar, advertir, recordar, reprochar, sugerir).
I can use the indicative after verbs that state a fact and the subjunctive after negar que.
I can use advertir and recordar with the indicative for a fact and the subjunctive for an order.
I can use the new words for pointing out, specifying and stressing.
